entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A devil planeswalker who narrates the saga in third person, boasting that he is sowing war across Kaldheim and has lured a planeswalker (Kaya) to Immersturm.

entities.name: Horrible Beast
entities.description: A monster who poisoned Tibalt with a 'seed' and forced him to cause a distraction on its behalf.

entities.name: Valki
entities.description: The god of lies, tricked and chained by Tibalt, who was imprisoned in King Narfi's palace in Karfell while Tibalt used his guise.

entities.name: King Narfi
entities.description: A frozen mummy king of Karfell with an army of Dread Marn who agreed to keep Valki imprisoned in return for first pick of treasure at the Doomskar.

entities.name: Koll the Forgemaster
entities.description: The greatest of the dwarves, the only one who can work Tyrite, who was making the Sword of the Realms and was pushed into his forge by Tibalt.

entities.name: Halvar
entities.description: The god of battle for whom the Sword of the Realms was meant, who once saved Koll from a giant wolf.

entities.name: King Harald
entities.description: The elf king of Skemfar, son of Hraldir, a proud, paranoid ruler who distrusts the Skoti and is persuaded by Tibalt to strike first.

entities.name: Hraldir
entities.description: The elf who united the warring clans of Wood and Shadow, father of Harald.

entities.name: Varragoth
entities.description: A demon master of the Skelle clan, whose return Tibalt promised.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: The first and oldest monster born of the World Tree, banished by the Skoti into the Cosmos, whom Tibalt unleashes on Starnheim.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: The planeswalker Tibalt plans to lure to Immersturm and kill.

entities.name: Dread Marn
entities.description: King Narfi's army of walking dead.

entities.name: Skoti
entities.description: The gods of Kaldheim, whom the elves distrust.

entities.name: Valkyries
entities.description: The duty-bound beings of Starnheim, immune to gold and politics.

entities.name: Skelle clan
entities.description: A vicious Bretagard clan promised the return of their demon master.

entities.name: Frost giants
entities.description: The giants of Surtland warned of troll incursions.

entities.name: Torga trolls
entities.description: Trolls awakened from long slumber.

entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: The realm of fire and demons Tibalt longs for.

entities.name: Karfell
entities.description: The coldest, most remote realm, where Valki is held.

entities.name: Skemfar
entities.description: The elf realm.

entities.name: Surtland
entities.description: The realm of frost giants.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: The realm of the Skelle clan.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: The Valkyries' realm that Tibalt attacks with Koma.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The tree linking Kaldheim's realms.

entities.name: Cosmos
entities.description: The void between the realms.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The Viking plane Tibalt plans to set ablaze.

entities.name: Sword of the Realms
entities.description: A blade of Tyrite that opens paths between all realms of Kaldheim, which Tibalt takes from Koll.

entities.name: Tyrite
entities.description: The hardened sap of the World Tree used to forge the Sword of the Realms.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: The coming clash of realms that Tibalt is engineering.

entities.name: Seed
entities.description: The poison with which the Horrible Beast controls Tibalt.

events.summary: Tibalt, narrating, boasts that his plotting will set Kaldheim ablaze, and tells the saga of a planeswalker named Tibalt.
events.quote: all of Kaldheim would be improved with a touch more fire, a dash of anarchy

events.summary: The Horrible Beast poisons Tibalt with a seed and forces him to cause a distraction, though Tibalt had already planned to stir up trouble.
events.quote: the Horrible Beast snuck up on him one day and stuck Tibalt with a nasty, tricky sort of poison

events.summary: Tibalt tricks Valki, the God of Lies, to use him as a disguise.
events.quote: It happened that this God of Lies, this Prince of Tricksters, was foolish enough to get lied to and tricked himself.

events.summary: Tibalt chains Valki and imprisons him in King Narfi's glacial palace in Karfell, striking a deal with Narfi.
events.quote: So long as Valki stayed deep in the dungeon of this King Narfi's glacial palace

events.summary: Disguised as Valki, Tibalt visits Koll the Forgemaster, who refuses to hand over the Sword of the Realms, and pushes him into his forge.
events.quote: so Tibalt did the realms a favor and pushed the obnoxious dwarf right into his own forge

events.summary: Tibalt, as Valki, convinces King Harald of Skemfar that the gods plan terrible things and that the elves must strike first.
events.quote: The only choice, if the elves were to survive, was clear: strike first.

events.summary: Tibalt stirs trouble in Surtland and Bretagard, warning frost giants of trolls and promising the Skelle the return of Varragoth.
events.quote: Tibalt sowed the seeds of war and chaos

events.summary: With the Sword of the Realms, Tibalt cuts open a doorway to Starnheim and unleashes Koma on the Valkyries.
events.quote: he cut open a doorway to the home of the Valkyries, where the Cosmos Serpent could make up for lost time

events.summary: Tibalt leaves a trail with the sword through Immersturm so a planeswalker will follow.
events.quote: he was leaving a trail, dragging the tip through the black basalt surface of Immersturm

events.summary: Tibalt foretells that he will kill the planeswalker and Kaldheim will burn.

relations.note: The beast poisoned Tibalt to force him to help.
relations.quote: stuck Tibalt with a nasty, tricky sort of poison
Tibalt wrapped Valki in magical chains and brought him to the coldest, most remote realm he could find: Karfell.

relations.note: Narfi's army is the Dread Marn.
relations.quote: Narfi and his Dread Marn—that's what this king called the walking stiffs making up his army

relations.note: Tibalt pushes Koll into his forge.
relations.quote: pushed the obnoxious dwarf right into his own forge

relations.note: The Skoti banished and trapped Koma in the Cosmos.
relations.quote: the Skoti had banished Koma from entering the realms, trapping him in the empty Cosmos
